title: Universal first-jet tensor vanishes on the actual singular fibre
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k smooth, L invertible, and s_i a finite family of sections, with the universal family [def-zl-bertini-universal-family]. Fix U open in Y, z in U, K=kappa_U(z), an open W containing U.ι(z), and a free generator e of L on W [def-sc-local-free-generator]. Put T equal to the actual singular fibre over z and A=Gamma(T,O_T), and let rho:K[x_i] -> A be the canonical coordinate homomorphism [lem-zl-bertini-singular-fibre-coordinates]. Give A the K-algebra structure rho composed with C. For a_i the actual coefficient of s_i restricted to W in e, the tensor sum_i rho(x_i) tensor bertiniLocalFirstJet(a_i) is zero in A tensor_K (K plus bertiniCotangentFibre f U z), with the jets of [lem-zl-bertini-local-first-jets]. This is only the value-and-differential relation on fixed geometric coordinates, with no existential presentation or surjectivity conclusion.

source.place: Tag 0FD6, lemma-bertini, final paragraph; supplemented by Morphisms Tag 02G1 and Algebra Tag 00T7

proof.text: Apply the comparison identity to obtain hV, the pulled frame ep, its coefficient F, and the injective additive map J. The tensor-pullback module is invertible by the canonical comparison with the usual pullback. In the private zeroLocus_coefficient_eq_zero lemma, pass to an affine neighbourhood, use ideal_zeroLocus to identify the ideal with the span of the coefficient, and ker_stalkMap to show that its germ pulls back to zero. Section extensionality proves F=0 on the zero scheme. Ring-section functoriality pulls this equality to the actual singular fibre.

The ambient projection is smooth by base change, hence its differential module is finite locally free. At every point of the reduced singular scheme, a nonzero ambient differential of F would give a smooth open neighbourhood by the proved hypersurface theorem, contradicting the definition of the singular locus. The private differential_zero_of_nonsmooth_zeroLocus makes this contradiction precise. The reduced induced closed-scheme instance and the proved reduced-factor section-vanishing lemma then make the pullback of dF to the actual fibre zero.

The comparison lemma sends the displayed jet tensor to the pair (g^*F,g^*dF). The preceding steps prove both entries zero. Use Prod.ext and preservation of zero by J, then its injectivity, to conclude the original tensor equals zero.

lean.statement:
theorem bertini_singular_fibre_jet_tensor
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (U : Y.Opens) (z : U) (W : Y.Opens) (hz : U.ι z ∈ W)
    (e : Γ(L, W)) (he : Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator e) :
    let K := (U : Scheme).residueField z
    let A := Γ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z, ⊤)
    let ρ := bertiniSingularFibreRingMap f L s U z
    letI : Algebra K A := (ρ.comp MvPolynomial.C).toAlgebra
    (∑ i, ρ (MvPolynomial.X i) ⊗ₜ[K]
      bertiniLocalFirstJet f U z W hz
        (he.coeff (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (s i))) :
      A ⊗[K] (K × bertiniCotangentFibre f U z)) = 0
